task_definition.task_description: Please check the living room light’s current status, then get its mesh snapshot and publish that snapshot to my app with high priority. After that, scan for smart devices in the living room, lock the main lock using PIN 2026, and then tell me the current local time in Los Angeles.

user_input.query: For user_42, please check the current status of my living room light, light_living, then get its mesh snapshot and publish that snapshot to my app on the app channel with high priority. After that, scan for smart devices in the living_room, lock the main lock lock_main by setting its state to lock using PIN 2026, and then tell me the current local time in Los Angeles, using the America/Los_Angeles timezone.

For user_42, please check the current status of my living room light, light_living, then get its mesh snapshot and publish that snapshot to my app on the app channel with high priority.
